//: Colours are lifted from src/index.css (the "Tüte" look, light theme) so the marketing set cannot drift from the app.
//font: The app's own typefaces, loaded from the app's bundled files (assets/fonts/fonts.css points at src/assets/fonts/): `display` sets the headline and the ribbon, `text` the subline and the points.
//backgrounds: Presets referenced by slide.background: one flat colour and what stands on it. fill = the canvas; ink = the headline; inkSoft = the subline; shade = the colour every shadow is mixed from (a darker tone of the fill, never grey); chip / chipInk / tick = a point's pill, its text and its tick; ribbon / ribbonInk = the corner ribbon. peach is the icon's own colour (--color-peach) with the app's ink on it, coral the app's button colour (--t-accent-fill) with white, plum the app's ink (--t-fg) as a canvas, for the screen shown at night. One preset for the whole set; plum only for the dark screen.
//device: The frame is drawn in CSS, not composited from a PNG (assets/frames/README.md); its proportions are in templates/slide.css. bezel is its colour: the app's night page, a warm black rather than a grey one.
